q: What are the emissions of running an ATM?
title: ATM emissions per machine
short: An ATM kiosk's emissions are mostly the air conditioner keeping the room cool, plus the machine, lights and UPS. Multiply the kiosk's units by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. If a site owner pays the bill and it is in your rent, it still needs counting, often as an estimate.

ul: Otherwise rated load times hours, labelled as an estimate.
Diesel, if a shared genset backs it.

p: ATMs run by a managed service provider sit in the bank's Scope 3 unless the bank pays the power bill.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
